Updated the editable scene and rendered the selected door swing. The diagnostic showed that the back wall was hiding the original leaf; the doorway is now cut into the wall. I compared hinge-swing and placement candidates and inspected top and side views.

Deliverables:

- `/app/scene.blend`
- `/app/final.png` (640 × 360)

The selected leaf is visible, though it remains narrower in the camera view than the broad foreground door in the reference.
